titleZh: 2026年农场进步展前瞻：新增农艺区与无人机专区
summaryZh: 2026年农场进步展将于9月1-3日在爱荷华州布恩举行，新增6英亩农艺区、首个FAA批准的无人机专区、田间演示及多个新展商。展会亮点包括Ag PhD专家导览、13台联合收割机田间作业、Case IH庆祝美国建国250周年设备展示，以及AGI新型提升设备预览。门票提前购买15美元，现场30美元，另有含午餐和纪念帽的60美元套餐。
featuredReason: 虽然展会以种植业为主，但无人机专区、精准农业和自主作业演示代表了智慧农业技术的前沿应用，对智慧畜牧行业从业者了解跨领域技术趋势具有参考价值。
contentFull:
Farm Progress Show

2026 Farm Progress Show preview

Video: The Farm Progress Show in Boone, Iowa, Sept. 1-3, debuts new Agronomy Zone, FAA-approved Drone Zone, field demos, and exhibitor previews.

August 13, 2026

The Farm Progress Show in Boone, Iowa, on Sept. 1-3 will offer more to see this year with new features, including the Agronomy Zone, the first official Drone Zone, new field demonstrations, updated ticketing options, and exhibitor previews from Morton Buildings, SprayTech, AGI, Case IH and Brink.

The Agronomy Zone will span about 6 acres in the southeast corner of the showgrounds. According to Matt Jungmann, senior director of events for Farm Progress, more than half of the participating companies are first-time exhibitors. Plots were planted this spring, and guided tours at 1 p.m. daily will be led by Ag PhD co-hosts Brian and Darren Hefty.

The Drone Zone makes its first FAA-approved appearance in Boone, featuring a clear-walled tent barrier and multiple exhibitors flying each show day, offering side-by-side comparisons for producers evaluating the technology.

Up to 13 combines will run across 80 acres of demo fields — planted in partnership with John Deere — with tillage, precision and autonomy demonstrations rounding out the field program. Corn was fully tasseled by July 4.

Related:2 free weather tools every farmer should know

Advance tickets are $15 through Aug. 28, increasing to $30 at the gate. A new $60 premium package — valued at $83 — includes admission, a lunch voucher and a vintage-style Farm Progress Show hat.

To celebrate the 250th anniversary of the nation, Case IH will display over 25 pieces of equipment, including the Heartland Magnum and Providence Magnum tractors, appearing together publicly for the first time.

Watch the video to hear Jason Jones, AGI sales director, preview a redesigned Brownie tower, a new mid-market bucket elevator and updated longer conveyors, with ordering expected by October.

Brink, a sister company to Idaho Forest Group, makes its Farm Progress debut with a forest-residual biostimulant and a display of restored prairie tractors and steam-powered cable plows — the collection’s first public showing.

New exhibitors, a third Varied Industries tent, and expanded crop-input demonstrations signal strong industry demand for the 2026 show, with the Agronomy Zone and Drone Zone marking the most significant additions to the event's format in its near-75-year history.This video summary was created with the help of Farm Progress' internal AI tool

translationZh:
2026年农场进步展将于9月1-3日在爱荷华州布恩举行，今年将有更多看点，包括新增的农艺区、首个官方无人机专区、新的田间演示、更新的票务选项，以及Morton Buildings、SprayTech、AGI、Case IH和Brink等展商的预览。

农艺区将占地约6英亩，位于展场东南角。据Farm Progress活动高级总监Matt Jungmann介绍，超过一半的参展公司是首次参展。地块已于今年春季播种，每天下午1点由Ag PhD联合主持人Brian和Darren Hefty带领导览。

无人机专区首次在布恩获得FAA批准，设有透明墙帐篷屏障，多个展商将在每个展会日进行飞行演示，为评估该技术的生产者提供并排对比。

多达13台联合收割机将在80英亩的演示田中进行作业——这些田地是与John Deere合作种植的——同时还有耕作、精准农业和自主作业演示。玉米在7月4日前已完全抽雄。

相关：每个农民都应知道的2个免费天气工具

提前购票至8月28日价格为15美元，现场购票为30美元。新的60美元高级套餐——价值83美元——包含门票、午餐券和一顶复古风格的农场进步展帽子。

为庆祝美国建国250周年，Case IH将展出超过25台设备，包括Heartland Magnum和Providence Magnum拖拉机，这两款机型将首次公开同台亮相。

观看视频，了解AGI销售总监Jason Jones预览重新设计的Brownie塔、新型中端斗式提升机和更新的加长输送机，预计10月可下单。

Brink是Idaho Forest Group的姊妹公司，将首次亮相农场进步展，展示一种森林残余物生物刺激素，以及修复过的草原拖拉机和蒸汽动力缆索犁——这是该收藏的首次公开展示。

新展商、第三个Varied Industries帐篷以及扩大的作物投入品演示表明2026年展会的行业需求强劲，其中农艺区和无人机专区是这场近75年历史活动形式中最重要的新增内容。

本视频摘要由Farm Progress内部AI工具协助创建
